title: Rafael and the Drop
author: A. M. Sandoval
blurb: Sebastian Joubert, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
